products.title: Ascent Book 14 Pro

specs.label: Battery
specs.value: 60 Wh, up to 11 h mixed use, 65 W USB-C charging

pros: 11-hour real-world battery life for back-to-back dev sessions
16 GB dual-channel LPDDR5X handles large monorepos and containers
Sharp 2880x1800 screen with a comfortable backlit keyboard
cons: RAM is soldered — buy 32 GB now if you expect to scale

images.alt: Ascent Book 14 Pro laptop, open at an angle

products.shortDescription: 14-inch developer ultrabook with 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD and an 11-hour battery.
products.description: The Ascent Book 14 Pro is built for people who compile code all day: a Ryzen 7 8845HS with sustained 45 W performance, a 400-nit 90 Hz display that is comfortable at any angle, and a keyboard that survives long typing sessions. At 1.29 kg it travels easily, and USB-C charging means one cable for the office and the road.

products.title: Ascent Book 14

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 16 GB DDR5-4800 (2 SO-DIMM, upgradeable to 64 GB)

specs.label: Storage

specs.label: Battery

products.shortDescription: Upgradeable 14-inch laptop with 16 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD.
products.description: If you want a laptop you can grow with, the Ascent Book 14 keeps the hinges on the buyer: two memory slots, two M.2 slots and a full-size keyboard. Performance is steady for compilers, containers and browsers, and the price leaves room in a $900 budget.

products.title: Vertex Ultra 15

specs.label: Battery

products.shortDescription: 15.6-inch 120 Hz laptop with 1 TB SSD and a 12-hour battery.
products.description: The Ultra 15 pairs the efficient Core Ultra 7 platform with a roomy 1 TB SSD and a 120 Hz display, which makes long scrolling through logs and dashboards noticeably easier on the eyes. Thunderbolt 4 keeps docking simple.

products.title: Vertex ProGamer 16

specs.label: Graphics

products.shortDescription: 16-inch RTX 4060 machine with 32 GB RAM for CUDA and 3D work.

products.title: NovaBook Air 13

specs.label: Battery

Bright 400-nit 2.5K panel

products.shortDescription: 1.18 kg 13-inch ultraportable with 16 GB RAM and a 10-hour battery.

products.title: NovaBook Studio 15

specs.label: Memory

analyticsSeed.$comment: Synthetic events so /merchant/analytics is not empty on day one. Generated deterministically with SEED=1337 by scripts/seed.ts.
analyticsSeed.notes: Distribution follows a mild weekly curve; views cluster on the G-01 laptop set so the funnel is plausible during a demo.

demoScenarios.$comment: Used by `pnpm demo` and the reset script to create reproducible talking points.

happyPath.prompt: I need a laptop for full-stack development under $900, with at least 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and good battery life
happyPath.note: Subtotal 87900 ($879) => free shipping, tax round(87900*0.0825)=7252, total 95152. Use the $429 PlayBook Go 14 or a two-item cart to exercise the $9.99 band, and the $149 Studio One for the $14.99 band.

demoScenarios.overBudgetPrompt: Actually make it under $700 and lighter than 1.4 kg

declineScenario.note: Enable PayPal negative testing (or use the declined buyer) to force INSTRUMENT_DECLINED on capture; expect order status payment_failed and a Retry payment action.

unavailableScenario.note: Set ascent-book-14-pro stock to 0 in /merchant/products while it sits in a cart; the next quote must return ITEM_UNAVAILABLE and exclude it from the total.

duplicateScenario.note: Double-click Approve & Pay; exactly one order, one PayPal order and one capture must exist.
